t.zh: 规则的结论不全是 ?：有些地方是确定的句子，目标在那里必须完全相同。拆开后，这样的地方成了「刮风 ≐ 刮风」，不含任何信息。新元件「删除」去掉这样的等式。
t.en: A rule’s conclusion is not all ?-letters: some places hold fixed sentences, and there the goal must be exactly the same. Split, such a place becomes “it is windy ≐ it is windy”, which says nothing. A new part, “Delete”, removes such equations.

t.zh: ¬A 在证明器里是 A → ⊥，也按这个结构拆。
t.en: ¬A in the prover is A → ⊥, and splits as such.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：把每组等式解到底，只留下 ?-字母的等式。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that solves each set of equations to the end, leaving only equations for ?-letters.

hint.zh: 先拆开，再看剩下的等式。
hint.en: Split first, then look at what is left.
